# intersex variation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intersexVariation`](gmeow-intersexVariation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intersexVariation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An optional free-text note recording an intersex variation, for inclusivity where [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md) [`gmeow:saabIntersex`](../individuals/gmeow-saabIntersex.md) is insufficient. Deliberately a plain note, NOT a clinical DSD taxonomy and NOT a value vocabulary — GMEOW does not model medical sex characteristics in depth.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use only to carry a brief free-text inclusivity note about an intersex variation that the coarse [`gmeow:saabIntersex`](../individuals/gmeow-saabIntersex.md) value cannot capture.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as a clinical DSD taxonomy or a value vocabulary, and avoid it for ordinary sex-assigned-at-birth recording (use [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md)); GMEOW does not model medical sex characteristics in depth.

### How to use

- Attach a short plain literal alongside [`gmeow:sexAssignedAtBirth`](gmeow-sexAssignedAtBirth.md) [`gmeow:saabIntersex`](../individuals/gmeow-saabIntersex.md); treat it as the deepest sensitivity and keep it out of public projections.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:intersexVariation`](gmeow-intersexVariation.md) "variation noted on record"@en.
